corporation_name.rationale: Corporation name is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule J canonical XSD candidates.

ein.rationale: EIN is a header/identifier field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule J canonical XSD candidates.

tax_year_begin.rationale: Tax year begin date is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule J canonical XSD candidates.

tax_year_end.rationale: Tax year end date is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule J canonical XSD candidates.

income_tax.rationale: IncomeTaxAmt corresponds to the income tax before credits line on Schedule J.

alternative_minimum_tax.rationale: CorpAlternativeMinimumTaxAmt directly represents the corporate AMT from Form 4626 on Schedule J.

additional_taxes.rationale: OtherTaxesAmt best represents additional taxes and amounts on Schedule J; however the blueprint bundles multiple items (recapture, BEAT, etc.) that the schema splits across multiple elements.

total_credits.rationale: TotalCreditAmt represents the total non-refundable credits on Schedule J reducing tax liability.

total_tax.rationale: TotalTaxAmt is the net total tax from Schedule J carried to page 1 of Form 1120.
